2788bfda581e001b2a1f069ce417cc8775a3d20d.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: an unhandled ZodError on a malformed body yields 500 instead of 400.

7794e89965e26d3ac89198560f9c1549b31708c8.titleReason: The title correctly says that a failed Twilio cancellation prevents the scheduled SMS reminder row from being deleted, which is the defect.

86f0b8b59cb3ada1396484aff94c1b9521032304.titleReason: The title correctly says that join() leaks processes still running after the timeout deadline, which is the defect described.

44ce8d07255b9ce5aa3740aa393a804487dd2070.titleReason: The title names the actual defect: the embed URL is placed unescaped into stored HTML, which allows XSS.

dc7aa7a90bd44044a218a22537a38557cf0e7168.titleReason: The title correctly identifies that the light-theme lightness for the group member `.name` was changed from 30% to 50%, which is the defect.

83e4aae4273f7f59997f4e1c710b194e61c0bfd1.titleReason: The title correctly states that add_members raises RecordNotUnique when a username is already a member or appears more than once, which is the defect.

d515372c760fcb68b149c3f6579960c3c9aa0753.titleReason: The title says the date-override early return skips the busy-time conflict check, which is exactly the defect described.

8929c6882659c74c4441db74c76dd671cad9c09b.titleReason: The title correctly states that the slug condition is inverted, so the slug is set only when billing is enabled.
8929c6882659c74c4441db74c76dd671cad9c09b.fixReason: The fix negates the condition on line 151, leaves the requestedSlug condition on line 153 correct and unchanged, and keeps the metadata structure intact.

aab09560e0794b43df3f8a28f02129a5d3964090.fixReason: With a try/catch around each reminder, one failed SendGrid cancel no longer stops the loop; successful cancels have their deletes run through Promise.allSettled, which invokes the lazy Prisma promises' then, and errors are logged without escaping, so the code after the block still runs with the same request body and rows.

4f410fed00d04e4396756dc6c0ff58282ef57b57.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: a placeholder refresh_token overwrites the real stored token whenever the response omits one.
4f410fed00d04e4396756dc6c0ff58282ef57b57.fixReason: The fix limits the placeholder injection to the same condition as the sharing branch, so the non-sharing path no longer adds a fake token, real tokens pass through unchanged, and the throw and return behavior stays the same.

e170989fc734761cd2193f806dda40ef4849fe74.titleReason: The title names the defect: SMS-locked reminders are wrongly counted as failures and end up deleted after retries.
e170989fc734761cd2193f806dda40ef4849fe74.fixReason: Replacing lines 178-186 with `}` leaves line 187's `}` in place, which adds an extra closing brace, so the try/catch structure breaks and the file will not compile (an empty replacement was needed).

8e682165250cd9afcf27a28a542d70b880cc2481.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: Dayjs objects are compared with `===`, so the full-day unavailable override check never fires.
8e682165250cd9afcf27a28a542d70b880cc2481.fixReason: Replacing `===` with `.isSame(...)` compares the adjusted times by value, so the find callback returns true when start equals end, and the other checks are left unchanged.

8be447797d113f06b9bfe9902e4014b52cb2e8c4.titleReason: The title states the defect: when a day has several date overrides, slots that sit inside one of them are wrongly marked unavailable.
8be447797d113f06b9bfe9902e4014b52cb2e8c4.fixReason: The code keeps only same-day overrides, sets dateOverrideExist, and accepts the slot if some override contains it under the same offset and boundary rules, treats start==end as containing nothing, and leaves the following dateOverrideExist short-circuit and the no-override path unchanged.

265666a489c204ea2b0d0800932f55315c42dc6b.titleReason: The title correctly names the defect: the guest blacklist check can be bypassed by changing the email's case or using a plus-address alias.
265666a489c204ea2b0d0800932f55315c42dc6b.fixReason: The inline normalizer lowercases both sides and strips the '+tag' before comparing, so blacklisted addresses are caught in either form, while guests keep their original strings, the attendee filter stays in place, and an empty or unset env var still blocks nothing.

67afa1aff7abd042fe915bc4d0004f2f51709a64.titleReason: The title correctly says the check uses && and so denies admins who are not owners, which is the defect.
67afa1aff7abd042fe915bc4d0004f2f51709a64.fixReason: Replacing && with || authorizes both admins and owners, still denies everyone else, and keeps the truthy semantics the later check relies on.

9120980409783a9af9fec987b230c255809f1f15.titleReason: The title correctly states that video booking references lose their credentialId because it is hard-coded to undefined.
9120980409783a9af9fec987b230c255809f1f15.fixReason: Using `result.credentialId` unconditionally restores the credential id for video results, keeps the per-result value for calendar results, and leaves externalCalendarId unchanged, which meets all obligations.

ed469cc18bcd3f29f675cd44bca430a4d40bb4f8.titleReason: The title names the defect: the recurring cancellation path ignores the resolved per-reference credential, so collective (co-host) events are mishandled.

e6f32e0527fab0d02956681eaac73ca3602e1826.titleReason: The title states the defect: createEvent always targets the first host's calendar no matter which credential is calling it.

575526dafce8c70d8fd6660fd9519fa9b958b01d.titleReason: The title correctly says that join() leaks the remaining flusher processes once the timeout deadline elapses, which is the defect.
575526dafce8c70d8fd6660fd9519fa9b958b01d.fixReason: The fix removes the break, keeps waiting bounded by the while-condition, terminates every process in a second loop with the isinstance guard intact, and keeps the timeout=None behavior of waiting for each process before terminating.

874f02dc1e5e0db7a1544be437de77b4e3cba8b8.titleReason: The title says filtered messages "never" have their offsets tracked, which repeats the finding's overstatement; the reference shows BrokerValue-wrapped filtered messages are tracked in the except branch, so offsets are only lost for plain Value messages.

9c4f6d62bf8b56713610b644fbd4ebcbd6b6d0a3.titleReason: The title names the defect: the work queues are unbounded and give no backpressure when traffic bursts.
